status.en: 10 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, most of them in Niamey, Dioura and Kidal.
status.nb: 10 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, flest i Niamey, Dioura og Kidal.

summary.en: Mali forces have retaken Kidal as jihadist attacks intensify, and a Mali drone strike killed 13 civilians while the army said it targeted militants. In Burkina Faso militants now control at least 40% of the country and a critic of Mali’s junta was forcibly disappeared, while the junta stripped five more exiled critics of nationality. In Niger a convoy carrying Governor Bago collided with a car, killing four students, a driver and a young woman, and Niger accused Chad of a drone attack that killed two civilians. Russia hosted African leaders to deepen ties, and the conflict produced 4,159 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Mali-styrkene har gjenerobret Kidal mens jihadistangrepene intensiveres, og et malisk droneangrep drepte 13 sivile etter at hæren hevdet at den hadde truffet militante. I Burkina Faso kontrollerer militante nå minst 40 % av landet, og en kritiker av Malis junta ble tvangsforsvunnet, mens junten fratok fem eksilkritikere nasjonalitet. I Niger kolliderte en konvoi med guvernør Bago med en bil, og fire studenter, en sjåfør og en ung kvinne ble drept, og Niger anklaget Tsjad for et droneangrep som drepte to sivile. Russland var vert for afrikanske ledere for å styrke båndene, og konflikten førte til 4 159 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: War in the Sahel
background.extract: The War in the Sahel, also known synonymously as the Sahel War is a multi-sided armed conflict that has been ongoing since 2012. In particular, the intensive conflict mainly takes place in the three countries of Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso.
